scope: Independent static review of the frozen feature-only exporter V3 and scorer V3 producer/consumer bindings. This is source-only: no B query/action, test/import execution, model or data payload read, prediction export, score, or quality claim was made by the reviewer.

exporter_v2_to_v3: Bind the V3 binding filename and exact binding digest.

Add strict canonical API pin validation against complete source-manifest rows both while loading the binding and after the 167-file source-tree verification; the exact eight expected paths and exact bytes/SHA fields are enforced.
Accept absent or null CONTROL input-representation mode only for the fixed base CONTROL arm; non-CONTROL arms retain exact mode checks.
Bind the new evaluation_v2 evidence/output root.

scorer_v2_to_v3.core_change: Only the expected binding SHA-256 literal changes; expected byte count is unchanged.
contract_changes: EXPORT_BINDING_V1.json becomes EXPORT_BINDING_V3.json at the two exact binding-path checks.
The private evidence-root basename changes from evaluation_v1 to evaluation_v2.

focused_fixture_scope.exporter_fixture_reads: Pinned local binding and source-manifest metadata plus ten exact small accepted-fit/exact-stop receipts; it substitutes fake digest results for source-tree, split, and model payload checks.
focused_fixture_scope.score_fixture_reads: Small V2/V3 binding JSON and source/manifest text only.
focused_fixture_scope.reported_ruff: Exporter Ruff format/check passed; scorer V3 narrow Ruff/check reported by author.

limitations: The source manifest's producer_contract source-review field still records its preparation-time pending label; this review resolves the source-only pair gate without changing any frozen manifest bytes.
The review covers code and bindings only. It does not establish current B path/state, fresh preflight results, successful export, or scored results.
The fixed models are selected at epoch 5 and the comparison uses fit-excluded but exposed development data; it is not a fresh/public holdout or a quality result.
reviewer_conclusion: The frozen exporter/scorer V3 pair binds the same V3 binding, source manifest, V2 private evidence root, fixed five-arm output contract, and exact producer code pin. The previous API manifest row-shape failure is corrected without changing inference, prediction generation, or scoring logic.
